purpose: Logical healthcare capabilities. Physical hosts are configured independently.

services.description: Assesses the arriving patient: sets a priority, orders tests, and sends the patient to diagnostics or straight to treatment. Simulated, with some random variation.
services.returns: Triage results with priority CRITICAL, URGENT or STANDARD. Routes on "STANDARD_WORKFLOW" (to the diagnostic tests) or "DIRECT_TO_TREATMENT".

services.description: Runs the ordered lab tests (simulated) and flags abnormal or critical values.
services.returns: Laboratory results and a clinical summary. No routing value.

services.description: Simulates an ECG and grades the patient's cardiac risk.
services.returns: Cardiology results with risk CRITICAL, HIGH, MODERATE or LOW. No routing value.

services.description: Chooses the imaging study for the presenting complaint and writes a simulated report.
services.returns: Radiology findings, impression and recommendations. No routing value.

services.description: Performs the same imaging study for another hospital and records an audit trail of the cross-facility request.
services.returns: Radiology results plus the requesting hospital and audit fields. No routing value.

services.description: Combines the lab, cardiology and radiology results into a diagnosis, a disposition and a treatment plan.
services.returns: Diagnosis results with a disposition: ICU, urgent admission, observation or outpatient follow-up. No routing value.

services.description: Gives the planned medications and procedures, judges the patient's response (simulated) and decides whether the patient can be discharged.
services.returns: Treatment results including discharge_ready. No routing value.

services.description: Treats a simple case sent straight from triage; a complex case is marked as needing a full workup.
services.returns: Treatment results with status TREATMENT_COMPLETE. No routing value.
